data.fund_name: SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund (formerly known as SBI Long Term Equity Fund)
data.fund_type: An open ended Equity Linked Saving Scheme with a statutory lock-in period of 3 years and tax benefit
data.investment_objective: The prime objective of this scheme is todeliver the benefit of investment in aportfolio of equity shares, while offeringdeduction on such investments made in thescheme under Section 80 C of the IncometaxAct, 1961. It also seeks to distributeincome periodically depending ondistributable surplus.
